correctness.rationale: Over R=Z/p^a, Smith normal form of T-I with exponents 0<=i<=j<=a identifies ker(T-I) as C_{p^i}⊕C_{p^j}. For mod-p nonunipotent trace≠2, T-I is invertible and there are v=p(p²-p-1) residue matrices; for nonidentity trace-two unipotents, a unit off-diagonal entry makes the lifted trace uniform and gives the stated i=0<j counts. For T=I+p^i C (i>=1), det T=1 is tr C+p^i det C=0; solving w=(-x+p^i yz)/(1+p^i x) identifies p³ traceless residue classes, p²(p-1) invertible C and p²-1 nonzero nilpotents. A unit off-diagonal entry makes det C uniform in p-adic fibers, giving remaining off-diagonal counts; the identity is unique. Independently enumerated determinant-one matrices in six small prime-power rings and matched full predicted (i,j) counts, including p=2. Summing counts gives |SL2|, while stabilized rational PGF follows from geometric series and has mass one. Endpoint j=a is counted separately.
residual_risks: Finite complete enumerations are only for selected p^a, not all primes and exponents.
More detailed arithmetic of trace fibers is needed for the analytic proof; its unit-coordinate parametrization has been independently checked in the relevant residue cases.
